runs.question: What fine does OMB M-25-21 set for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline?

answer.text:
The passages I found don't say that OMB M-25-21 sets a fine for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline. I searched the memo for a penalty and found nothing, though I didn't read every page.

The passages on AI strategies and related deadlines give requirements but no financial penalty. One example is the compliance plan. Within 180 days of the memo's issuance, each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly either a plan to achieve consistency with the memo or a written determination that it doesn't use and doesn't anticipate using covered AI. The strategy passages say strategies should be understandable, accessible to the public, and transparent about how AI investments benefit the American people.

support.reason: Passage states 180 days, submit to OMB and post publicly, plan or written determination of no covered AI use, matching the claim.
Passage says strategies should be understandable, accessible to the public, and transparent about how AI investments benefit the American people.

citations.cited_text: Consistent with Section 104( c) and ( d) of the AI in Government Act of 2020, within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to 0MB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AL Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum.23 0MB will provide templates for these compliance plans.
